```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r}
library(REDCapCDMSTAT)
nx <- cdmstat_demo(dir = file.path(tempdir(), "reports"), reset = TRUE, actor = "dana")
```

## Data cuts

A cut is an immutable snapshot of the data and dictionary. Its SHA-256 hash
is recorded in the ledger, and it can be signed off:

```{r}
cut <- nx$freeze("Final analysis", "Database locked 2026-10-01")
nx$sign_off(cut, "Database locked; all queries closed")
nx$cuts()[, c("cut_id", "label", "n_records", "signed_off_by", "sha256")]
```

`nx$use_cut(cut, require_signoff = TRUE)` points every analysis method at the
cut, verifying its hash first. A modified cut file is refused.

## The Quarto report

```r
render_report(dir = nx$dir, cut_id = cut, require_signoff = TRUE)
```

The template (`inst/quarto/cdmstat-report.qmd`) contains:

- cut provenance: hash, sign-off and dictionary hash
- data quality at the time of the cut
- Table 1 with the test rationale
- longitudinal trend plots
- a Cox model and an ANCOVA
- the replay script

It renders with the Quarto CLI if available, otherwise with rmarkdown (needs
pandoc), otherwise with knitr and markdown. See the
[sample report](https://github.com/neu-data/REDCapCDMSTAT/blob/main/examples/sample-report.html)
in the repository.

## CDISC SDTM, define.xml and ODM

```{r}
nx$code_terms("ae_term")
sdtm <- nx$sdtm()
sapply(sdtm, nrow)
head(sdtm$DM[, c("USUBJID", "SITEID", "AGE", "SEX", "ARM")], 3)
head(sdtm$VS[, c("USUBJID", "VSTESTCD", "VSORRES", "VSORRESU", "VISIT")], 3)
head(sdtm$AE[, c("USUBJID", "AETERM", "AEDECOD", "AESEV", "AESER")], 3)
```

`nx$export_cdisc(dir)` writes each domain as CSV and SAS transport (`.xpt`).
It adds a Define-XML 2.0 file (dataset and variable metadata) and the whole
study as CDISC ODM 1.3:

```{r}
basename(nx$export_cdisc(file.path(tempdir(), "cdisc")))
```

The mapping from study fields to SDTM variables is guessed from common field
names by `sdtm_default_map()`. For a real study, review it and pass your own
with `nx$sdtm(map = )`. The define.xml file has no controlled-terminology
code lists, so run a conformance checker such as Pinnacle 21 before a
submission.

## Replay script

```{r}
nx$table_one()
nx$fit("sbp__week_24 ~ arm + sbp__baseline")
cat(nx$script(), sep = "\n")
```
